data.name: Haleon Pakistan Limited
data.description: Haleon Pakistan Limited (formerly known as GlaxoSmithKline Consumer Healthcare Pakistan Limited) was incorporated in Pakistan as a public listed company under the provisions of the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984 (now Companies Act, 2017) on 31 March 2015. The Company is a subsidiary of ‘Haleon Netherlands B.V’. The ultimate parent of the Company is Haleon plc. The Company is inter alia principally engaged in the manufacturing, marketing and sale of consumer healthcare and over the counter health products.
